verdict.rationale: Twenty provides the building blocks—custom fields for deal value/stage/close date, dashboards with configurable charts, filters, aggregation, and grouping, and docs explicitly mention tracking 'pipeline health, team performance, revenue trends'—but there is no dedicated forecasting feature that models stage-probability-weighted revenue projections; a founder would need to manually configure fields and dashboard aggregations to approximate this. Missing for 10: a native weighted-pipeline forecast report, explicit stage-probability calculation logic, and any hands-on evidence of this being used for revenue forecasting.
